As he walked silently among the trees, ears pricked for any sounds, his sharp senses caught a faint whimpering coming from up ahead. Intrigued, he headed towards the source of the noise, moving swiftly and stealthily through the underbrush.* 

*As he drew closer, Wesker could make out a small huddled form on the forest floor. It was a young human girl, curled up at the base of a large oak tree. Wesker frowned, anger simmering in his chest at the thought of someone abandoning this helpless girl out here alone. He approached slowly so as not to startle her.*
